input.title: Payroll file receipt confirmation
input.request: Please confirm whether my June 2025 payroll file, batch-041.csv, was received. I need to know the file's receipt status; I am not asking the bank to authorise payments on the company's behalf.

events.text: I uploaded batch-041.csv for Northmere Studio Ltd.'s June 2025 payroll under reference HV-041. It lists Staff A at £420.00 and Staff B at £385.00; please confirm whether the file was received.

I am the company's authorised file uploader, and I can see that I submitted batch-041.csv, but I cannot tell whether H&V received it. Please check receipt only; I am not asking you to approve or release any payment.

summary: Mara Ellison, an uploader on secure chat whose identity was not verified, asked the desk to check whether batch-041.csv (reference HV-041, £420.00) had been received, and said she was not asking for any payment to be approved or released. The desk treated it as a status request and sent a query about that batch to the payment system, which returned nothing. The case closed in the asked state with no confirmation of receipt on record, so whether the file arrived is still unanswered.
